gating_policy_prose: The pre-target gate should 'terminate' early (before delivery-target selection) when the incoming event clearly does not warrant credential delivery, naming the specific disqualifier in the rationale. Terminate when the event represents a sub-competency or granular skill outcome that is a component of a larger parent competency — these partial mastery signals do not individually earn a credential. There is no boolean flag for this: read it structurally from the learning outcome's id/title prefix, which follows the numbering convention 'X.0.0' for a parent competency and 'X.Y.0' with a non-zero middle segment (for example '1.2.0') for a sub-competency. Terminate when the outcome contains a failing grade or an explicit failure indicator, meaning the learner did not successfully demonstrate the required competency. Pass/fail is not baked into the event as a boolean: for course_completed events judge the 'final_grade' and 'final_score' fields, treating a final_score below 60 — a letter grade of F — as failing. Terminate when the learner's profile or consent state indicates they have declined or not accepted badge issuance. When none of these disqualifiers are present, return 'continue' so the workflow proceeds to select appropriate delivery channels.

actions.description: Resolves the learner's LearnCard profile using a profile identifier (profile_id). Looks up the learner's wallet profile and delivery configuration in the LearnCard network so subsequent steps have a validated recipient to issue and deliver credentials to. This step is a prerequisite for all LearnCard-specific issuance and delivery steps.

Calls the Field Mapping LLM Decision Service to produce a field-level mapping specification for the credential_template phase — the achievement definition (name, description, criteria) derived from LMS learning-context artifacts. Runs after resolve_learncard_profile and before any issuer-payload step, since the issuer payload mapping reads the stored credential template as a source artifact. This is the field-mapping seam for the credential-template phase. It will also generate the input payload for the credential template synthesis step.

Calls the Field Synthesis LLM Decision Service to synthesize credential-template fields that cannot be directly mapped — for example, the achievement description or criteria narrative. Works from the mapping produced in the previous step and the original event context.

Executes the deterministic translation of the source event data into the credential-template payload, applying the credential template mapping and synthesis results to produce the stored credential template that the issuer-payload phase reads as a source artifact. This is the translation executor seam for the credential-template phase.

Calls the Field Mapping LLM Decision Service to produce a field-level mapping specification for constructing the LearnCard issuer payload. The mapping describes how event and context fields correspond to the Open Badge credential fields the issuer expects. This is the field-mapping seam for the issuer credential path. Runs after execute_credential_template_translation, whose output (the stored credential template) this mapping reads as a source artifact (ADR-0017 Phase 2); this step's own output feeds execute_issuer_payload_translation.

Calls the Field Synthesis LLM Decision Service to synthesize any credential fields that cannot be directly mapped from existing event data — for example, generating a human-readable achievement description or deriving metadata. Works from the mapping produced in the previous step and the original event context.

Executes the actual translation of the source event data into the LearnCard issuer payload format, applying the mapping and synthesis results. Produces the fully-formed credential payload ready to be submitted to the LearnCard issuer service. This is the translation executor seam for the issuer path.

Submits the translated issuer payload to the LearnCard issuer service to create and sign a verifiable Open Badge credential. Returns the issued credential artifact (the signed badge) that will subsequently be delivered to the learner's wallet. Requires the issuer payload produced by execute_issuer_payload_translation.

Calls the Field Mapping LLM Decision Service to produce a field-level mapping specification for constructing the LearnCard wallet delivery payload. The wallet delivery format differs from the issuer payload format, so a separate mapping step is needed. This is the field-mapping seam for the wallet delivery path. Runs after issue_learncard_badge; its output feeds execute_learncard_wallet_payload_translation.

Executes the translation of the issued credential into the LearnCard wallet delivery payload, applying the wallet mapping. Produces the fully-formed wallet payload ready for delivery. Requires the issued credential from issue_learncard_badge and the resolved profile. This is the translation executor seam for the wallet path.

Delivers the wallet payload to the learner's LearnCard wallet using the resolved profile's wallet endpoint. This is the final delivery step for the LearnCard wallet target. Requires the wallet payload produced by execute_wallet_payload_translation.

Calls the Field Mapping LLM Decision Service to produce a field-level mapping specification for constructing the SmartResume delivery payload. The SmartResume delivery format differs from the issuer and LearnCard wallet payload formats, so a separate mapping step is needed. Runs after issue_learncard_badge; its output feeds execute_smartresume_payload_translation. This is the field-mapping seam for the SmartResume delivery path.

Executes the translation of the issued credential into the SmartResume delivery payload, applying the SmartResume mapping. Produces the fully-formed SmartResume payload ready for delivery. Requires the issued credential from issue_learncard_badge, the resolved profile, and the mapping from generate_smartresume_payload_mapping. This is the translation executor seam for the SmartResume path.

Delivers the SmartResume payload to the learner's SmartResume record using the resolved profile. This is the final delivery step for the SmartResume target. Requires the SmartResume payload produced by execute_smartresume_payload_translation.
